input.canonical_provenance_string: PFEG CoastWatch ERDDAP (ncdcOisst21Agg; NOAA OISST v2.1 Final, AVHRR-Only; DOI 10.25921/RE9P-PT57)
input.pull_historical: 2026-06-29 (1982-2025; OISST Final is immutable, verified fresh-vs-cached diff = 0 cells for 2010 and 2025)

climatology.step_1: for each day-of-year d, pool SST from DOY in [d-5, d+5] (11-day window, wrap-around) across the 30 baseline years; mu(d) = mean, theta90(d) = 90th percentile
climatology.step_2: smooth BOTH mu(d) and theta90(d) with a 31-day centred day-of-year rolling mean (wrap-around)
climatology.leap_day: DOY 366 kept; stabilised by the smoothing window
climatology.ice_masking: SST set NaN where the OISST ice fraction exceeds 0.15, applied identically when building the baseline and when detecting daily exceedance

detection.exceedance: x = max(0, SST - theta90); exceedance day iff x > 0
detection.step_1: keep runs of >= 5 CONSECUTIVE exceedance days
detection.step_2: then merge two kept events separated by a gap of <= 2 days; absorbed gap days become part of the event
detection.note: the >= 5 test applies to consecutive exceedance BEFORE any bridging. This is the letter of Hobday et al. (2016) and what heatwaveR / Oliver's marineHeatWaves implement. The legacy 'bridged_run' mode, which let events confirm on as few as 2 consecutive days, was corrected 2026-07-20 and no shipped result uses it.
detection.A: 1 on every day of a confirmed (possibly merged) event, counted from the event's physical start

intensity_reference.I: I = SST - mu, the SIGNED anomaly above the seasonal climatological mean (heatwaveR 'relSeas'), NOT clamped at 0 and NOT referenced to theta90
intensity_reference.note: Hobday et al. (2016) Table 2 defines i_max / i_mean / i_cum relative to the seasonal mean. The clamp is omitted so i_mean, i_cum and the onset start-edge term match the reference implementation exactly.

aggregation_equations.area_frac: area_frac[t] = sum_g(w_g * A_g[t]) / sum_g(w_g), summed over the zone's mask cells, w_g = cos(lat)
aggregation_equations.conditional_mean: Xbar[t] = sum_g(w_g * X_g[t] * A_g[t]) / sum_g(w_g * A_g[t]); Xbar[t] = 0 when the denominator is 0 (no active cells)

area_frac.meaning: cos(lat)-weighted fraction of the zone's grid cells in a confirmed active MHW on day t

Ibar.meaning: weighted mean over active cells of I = SST - mu (signed, unclamped)

Dbar.meaning: weighted mean over active cells of D, the 1-based day index within the cell's current event (D on the event's last day == Hobday duration = te - ts + 1)

Cbar.meaning: weighted mean over active cells of C, the running cumulative sum of I from the event start (C on the event's last day == Hobday i_cum). Signed, because I is signed.

Obar.meaning: weighted mean over active cells of O, the Hobday onset rate, placed on the event's START day: O = (i_peak - i_start_edge) / ((t_peak - ts) + 0.5) with i_start_edge = 0.5 * (I[ts] + I[ts-1]). O = 0 on all other days; O = 0 for an event truncated at the series start (Hobday reports NA).
Obar.caveat: SIGNED AND UNCLAMPED in this vintage (SDL-030). Five negative values exist, all in Chukchi/Beaufort. Anything that log-transforms Obar, takes a rate magnitude, or filters >= 0 will mis-handle them. This is faithful to Oliver's marineHeatWaves and heatwaveR, verified against both sources.

date_column.name: date
date_column.monthly: YYYY-MM-01 (a first-of-month date, NOT a year_month period)

columns.monthly_rule: calendar-month mean of the daily series
columns.monthly_terminal_caveat: the 2026-07 monthly point is the mean of a single day (2026-07-01), because the series ends there. Do not read it as a collapse.

zones.definition_credit: ecosystem subareas of NOAA AFSC Ecosystem Status Reports (Ortiz and Zador 2024); Chukchi and Beaufort are the NPFMC Arctic Management Area (US EEZ, Marine Regions MRGID 8463), split at Point Barrow 156.47 W

exclusivity_of_reconstruction.claim: no script outside this pipeline reconstructs the nine-zone series from OISST
exclusivity_of_reconstruction.verified: 2026-09-30, by inspection of every caller in the repo
exclusivity_of_reconstruction.sole_production_path: mhw.states.update_states.run_state_engine / backfill_main -> mhw.states.aggregates.aggregate_region. The detection functions (qualify_mhw_events, active_flag_from_exc, finalize_events_grid) have exactly one production caller and are otherwise referenced only by tests/test_states.py.
nearby_code_that_is_NOT_a_reconstruction: scripts/validate_onset_vs_marineheatwaves.py — runs Oliver's verbatim marineHeatWaves detection+onset on the ALREADY-BUILT theta90/mu and I for one cell, to cross-validate the engine. It consumes derived products; it does not read OISST and does not build a series.
src/mhw/forecast/exceedance.py — consumes (theta90 - mu) as a threshold for a forecast product. Does not produce the predictand and is not wired to the board.
src/mhw/fetch/psl_mhw.py — downloads NOAA PSL's own published MHW probability product. A third-party forecast field, not our series.
src/dashboard/, src/api/ — read the generated parquet/zarr only.
